title: Analyzing Antisemitism: Insights with ML
summary: A data cleaning, labeling, and machine learning pipeline analyzing campus antisemitism incident reports and their relation to Jewish holidays. The apparent 'sdv' string is merely part of a local conda cache file path in requirements.txt, unrelated to the Synthetic Data Vault library.
evidence: requirements.txt: 'more-itertools @ file:///private/var/folders/.../abs_e2687gwsdv/croot/...' – 'sdv' is part of a random temp folder name, not the library
